notes: «وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ» is a passive verb with no transmitter; the chain starts at روح
The Imam «أبي عبد الله» is written inside the chain after «عن», so he stays a narrator (owner ruling 2); his words follow as the saying

fixes.reason: RWY takes the passive verb «روي» for a first narrator; the text's chain starts at روح بن عبد الرحيم.
